main_text.p: fructus unquā in sobole procreāda constitutus est. hoc cenim cum bestijs cōmune habēt. ex ea igit re illarū fructus æstimatur, ac cēsetur, q; ipsarū est proprius, ac singularis: & quo cæteris animantib. ante cellūt, nimirū ex industria & opera. F. At usufructuarij omnis utilitas est, quæcūq; ex muliere capi potest, siue principaliter, siue secūdariò ea nascatur. D. An cùm usufru-ctuarij sit omnis ancillarum utilitas, etiam illarum partus ipsius esse debeant. Quæ cō-trouersia ex ratiocinatione petitoris nascitur, similem est se rationem argumentantis, usu-

page.notes: The line "ex ea igit re illarū" appears as printed; the word "igit" may be an abbreviation or misprint for "igitur". The word "q;" before "ipsarū" is uncertain. The word "prin cipaliter" is printed with a line break and no visible hyphen, so it is joined here. The marginal decoration at the top is not text. Faint marks at the lower left edge are show-through and are not transcribed.
